claim: With the balanced only AZ strategy, EC2 Auto Scaling keeps trying to launch in the failing Availability Zone rather than shifting capacity to another zone; it suits quorum-based workloads.
question: How does the balanced only Availability Zone strategy react to a failed launch?

values.display: will continue to attempt to launch instances in the Availability Zone

evidence.quote: If launch attempts fail in an Availability Zone, Auto Scaling will continue to attempt to launch instances in the Availability Zone. This strategy is important to meet certain requirements such as quorum-based workloads or if your Auto Scaling group can tolerate the loss of an Availability Zone because you have sufficient capacity in the remaining Availability Zones.
